# AcePharm — Revision Platform for UK Pharmacy Students

> Created by pharmacists. Built for pharmacy students. Designed exclusively for UK MPharm students, foundation trainees, and GPhC registration assessment candidates.

## What is AcePharm?
AcePharm (https://acepharm.co.uk) is an independent UK pharmacy educational revision platform combining single best answer clinical questions, pharmaceutical calculations, four-stage structured explanations, and pre-submission confidence-accuracy calibration analytics.

## Clinical & Grounding Invariants
- All questions undergo triple review: clinical, educational, and editorial.
- All rationales are directly referenced to current British National Formulary (BNF) and NICE clinical guidelines.
- Ace AI is strictly grounded in reviewed curriculum content, never gives patient-specific advice, and provides structured citations on every response.

## Legal & Disclaimers
- Educational Disclaimer: AcePharm is an educational resource. It does not provide patient-specific medical advice and does not replace official guidance, university teaching, professional supervision, clinical judgement, or local policies.
- Independence Disclaimer: AcePharm is an independent educational platform. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the General Pharmaceutical Council (GPhC), universities, NICE, or the NHS unless explicitly stated.
